detector_frozen.bull_predicate: For persistent zone [lo, hi], on a closed RTH 5m bar: F1 open >= lo (bar begins at/above the shelf -- tests it as support, excludes upward breakouts from below); F2 low <= hi (wick penetrates into the zone); F3 close >= hi - WICK_CLOSE_TOLERANCE (recovered to/above the zone top; the zone was never lost on a close); F4 (close - low) >= max(WICK_MIN_DOLLARS, WICK_MIN_PCT_OF_RANGE * (high - low)) (significant lower wick). Constants are the PRODUCTION wick-detector module constants imported from backtest/lib/filters.py (0.10 / 0.15 / 0.50) -- zero new tunables. Tiebreak among multiple fired zones: highest band_high (nearest defended shelf). Same-bar bull+bear collision: bull wins (primary lane), collisions counted.
detector_frozen.bear_predicate_secondary: Exact mirror at an overhead persistent zone: F1 open <= hi; F2 high >= lo; F3 close <= lo + WICK_CLOSE_TOLERANCE; F4 (high - close) >= same threshold. Tiebreak lowest band_low. SECONDARY cohort -- own tracker, own gates, reported regardless.
detector_frozen.trigger_level_for_structure_stop: FAR zone edge: bull -> band_low, bear -> band_high (invalidation = the zone actually fails on a closed 5m bar, J zone doctrine). NOT swept.
detector_frozen.no_other_knobs: Zero search space. One predicate per side, production constants throughout, one exit shape, one sizing. Dose-response gate is N/A because NOTHING is swept.
